baseline_models.focus_anchor: The predication of becoming links the mountain's elevated solid mass to the comparison term's soft dyed wool and limp bending.
baseline_models.mechanism: A maximally rigid, elevated body is assigned a new timed state whose material qualities are softness, fiber, color, and deformation without immediate separation. The comparison therefore stages a reversal of material behavior, not color resemblance alone.

activation_trace.role: Temporal occurrence and predication make the comparison a newly realized state rather than an atemporal label.
The high solid mass supplies maximal elevation and rigidity as the starting material.
Dyed soft wool supplies the terminal material's color, fibers, and softness.
Limp bending without full separation supplies deformation and weakened cohesion before complete dispersal.

changed_reading.before: The mountains are compared to colored wool mainly in appearance.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a timed phase reversal in which the world's hardest elevated masses become soft, bendable fiber, with cohesion failing before total separation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A textile branch within the mountain root meets the explicit wool branch of the comparison term.
baseline_models.mechanism: The mountain side contributes firm, well-twisted weaving while the comparison side contributes soft dyed wool. Read across that shared material domain, the movement runs backward from finished tight fabric to loose fiber, as though the built world's weave is being unmade.

activation_trace.role: Firm construction of woven cloth supplies a tightly integrated fabric image on the mountain side.
Soft dyed wool supplies the loose fibrous material into which the firm weave is imaginatively reversed.

changed_reading.before: The simile moves one way from mountain to a visually lighter material.
changed_reading.after: The paired branches permit a de-fabrication reading: a tightly made world is returned to unbound fiber.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The mountain root can image difficulty and prevention, while the comparison root can image what is ready, near, and accessible.
baseline_models.mechanism: The predicated change reverses a terrain-scale obstruction into immediately available material. Solidity is not only weakened; the blocking function of the mountain is canceled.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence in time supplies the hinge by which one functional state becomes another.
Difficulty and prevention make the mountain an obstacle as well as a hard object.
Readiness, nearness, and accessibility supply the opposite functional state.

changed_reading.before: The verse depicts mountains becoming fragile.
changed_reading.after: It can also depict the cancellation of obstruction: what was impassable becomes immediately accessible material.

context_deltas.mechanism: The severe event announced as falling or arriving opens into two consecutive material conversions: the upper canopy becomes molten matter, then elevated solid terrain becomes soft fiber. The focus image is one stage in a coordinated phase-change field from sky to ground.

activation_trace.role: A severe descending event supplies the initiating pressure under which the later transformations are read.
The sky as the covering upper expanse supplies the first cosmic layer subjected to material change.
Molten substances and residues supply liquefaction as the sky's counterpart to the mountain's fibering.
Timed occurrence makes the focus conversion the second realized phase in the sequence.
The elevated solid mass supplies the terrestrial material that changes after the canopy.
Soft dyed wool supplies fibering as a distinct response to the same event.

structural_cues: 70:8 and 70:9 are consecutive parallel clauses built from the day frame, becoming, a definite cosmic mass, and a material comparison.
The sequence moves vertically from the covering sky to the raised terrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a severe event and paired material similes; I supply the causal arrow that one pressure drives different phase changes in different layers. A live alternative is that the two images are coordinated signs without a shared physical process.

changed_reading.before: The mountain-wool comparison is an isolated image of fragility.
changed_reading.after: It is the ground-level phase of a vertically ordered transformation field: the canopy liquefies while the terrain fibers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opposed estimates of distance activate the comparison root's ready and near branch against the mountain root's obstruction branch. The mountain's softening now materializes the collapse of delay and mediation: the apparently remote event becomes unobstructed and imminent.

activation_trace.role: Distance from nearness supplies the human estimate that the event remains remote.
Temporal nearness and impending completion reverse the estimate of delay.
Difficulty and prevention let the mountain embody the mediation that makes arrival seem remote.
What is ready, near, and accessible supplies the mountain's newly unobstructive state.

structural_cues: 70:6 and 70:7 place the same event under directly opposed far and near predicates.
The material transformations follow immediately after the distance correction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed temporal perspectives plus obstruction and accessibility branches; I infer that topographic softening embodies the removal of delay. The live alternative is that nearness is purely temporal and does not govern the material image.

changed_reading.before: The mountains lose hardness at a future catastrophe.
changed_reading.after: Their loss of obstruction makes the supposedly distant event experientially near: no stable barrier remains between observer and arrival.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context inventories concentric forms of cohesion: intimate kin, clan, sheltering attachment, and total gathering. Their failure as rescue activates the mountain's multitude branch and the wool's fibrous plurality. A single imposing social mass is re-seen as separable strands whose former bonds no longer carry protection.

activation_trace.role: Near kinship supplies the smallest and most intimate unit of social cohesion, explicitly unable to function normally.
A person's clan supplies the wider collective body offered as a failed shelter or ransom.
Joining a gathering that gives refuge supplies the protective function that the kin group can no longer perform.
Joining dispersed parts into a whole supplies the maximal social aggregate that still cannot rescue.
Mountain-like abundance supplies a collective mass rather than geology alone.
Soft wool supplies many fibers whose visual unity need not preserve protective social cohesion.

structural_cues: 70:10 blocks ordinary exchange between intimates, then 70:11-14 expands the imagined ransom from children through close relations to everyone on earth.
The relation chain widens while its capacity to save remains zero.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nested bonds, failed refuge, gathering, and the focus's mass-to-fiber contrast; I supply the arrow from material fibering to social de-cohesion. The live alternative is that the kin sequence and cosmic image remain separate registers.

changed_reading.after: The image can also expose social mass as granulated: kin, clan, and humanity remain numerous but cease to cohere as rescue-bearing structures.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mountain root's formed-nature branch meets the claim that the human was created with a rapidly disturbed disposition, then the paired behaviors of broken patience and withheld giving. The mountain's becoming limp without severance becomes a material analogy for a constitution that looks fixed yet bends sharply under contact with harm or good.

activation_trace.role: Inner disposition or nature supplies the anthropological register of created constitution.
Anxious greed and rapid disturbance supply the constitution's unstable default response.
The cutting off of patience supplies one direction in which the disposition deforms under harm.
Withholding the hand from giving supplies the opposite deformation under good.
Innate formed nature makes the mountain lexeme available as an image of apparently fixed constitution.
Limp bending without complete separation supplies a model of deformation that does not erase identity.

structural_cues: 70:19 uses passive creation followed by a disposition predicate.
70:20 and 70:21 repeat the same contact construction and produce opposite failures under harm and good.
The exception beginning at 70:22 prevents the default disposition from being read as exhaustive destiny.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies formed nature in the focus and created disposition in context; I supply the terrain-to-psychology analogy and treat bending as behavioral deformation. A live alternative is that the shared constitution imagery is suggestive but not a designed cross-domain mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The mountain transformation concerns fixed external nature.
changed_reading.after: It can also model the pliability of created disposition: what appears mountain-fixed bends under pressure, while disciplined exceptions show that the default need not be final.

context_deltas.mechanism: After natural solidity is revoked, the exempt community is described through continuity, fixed obligation, kept covenant, uprightness, and guarding. Stability migrates from monumental matter to maintained practice: terrain does not endure by being hard, but commitments endure by being repeatedly enacted.

activation_trace.role: Stillness and continuance supply temporal durability as an enacted practice.
A binding fixed entitlement supplies durable obligation rather than mere possession.
A preserved covenant supplies relational stability secured through fidelity.
Uprightness, balance, and straightness supply a human form of structural integrity.
Persistent guarding supplies the repeated work by which integrity is maintained.
The high solid mass supplies natural durability only to have that durability revoked.
Soft wool supplies the failure of passive material firmness against which practiced durability stands.

structural_cues: The repeated relative clauses enumerate maintained practices rather than inherited status.
Prayer continuity opens the exempt list and prayer guarding closes it, forming a durable frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a collapsed natural monument and a dense vocabulary of continuity, obligation, covenant, uprightness, and guarding; I supply the transfer of stability from matter to practice. A live alternative is that the ethical list exempts people without deliberately answering the mountain image.

changed_reading.before: Mountains are the obvious emblem of durability, and their softening means all stability ends.
changed_reading.after: The verse demotes passive natural solidity so that durable structure can reappear as continuity, obligation, covenant, upright witness, and guarded practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence moves from known created origin through effective power to change of form or replacement. Read backward, the mountain's transformation is a demonstrative precedent: no created constitution, rank, or body is too established to be reconfigured.

activation_trace.role: Origination of created beings supplies the dependence of apparently stable forms.
Effective capacity that reaches action supplies the agency behind reconfiguration.
Changing a thing's form supplies the explicit contextual operation mirrored by mountain-to-wool becoming.
Timed becoming supplies the focus's realized change of state.
Formed nature supplies the kind of constitution whose apparent fixity is challenged.
Bending and partial breakage without disappearance supply transformed continuity rather than simple annihilation.

structural_cues: 70:39-41 advances from created origin to power and then to replacement with something better.
The focus likewise predicates a new state of an existing subject rather than merely removing the subject.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit creation-power-change sequence and the focus supplies metamorphosis; I infer that the earlier cosmic image serves as a material precedent for later replaceability. A live alternative is that the two passages independently display power without a retrospective link.

changed_reading.before: Mountain-to-wool is destruction of a unique natural object.
changed_reading.after: It becomes a paradigm of created replaceability: even deeply formed structures can persist as subjects while their operative form is changed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing scene coordinates rapid directed motion toward an erected marker with lowered vision, overpowering pressure, and broken status. Against it, high solid mountains become limp. The focus now participates in a choreography that reverses vertical prestige and converts autonomous mass into compelled flow.

activation_trace.role: Motion contrary to slowness supplies the crowd's accelerated, no-longer-deliberative movement.
An object erected upright and conspicuous supplies the fixed vertical target toward which the crowd is driven.
Lowering and submission supply the bodily reversal of height and self-possession.
Overtaking and overpowering pressure supplies the force that covers and controls the agents.
Breakage under domination supplies the collapse of social and bodily status.
High solid mass supplies the strongest vertical body whose prestige and resistance are reversed.
Limp bending without separation supplies loss of resistance while the subject remains present.

structural_cues: 70:43 combines emergence, speed, comparison, and a conspicuous destination before 70:44 shifts to lowered vision and covering humiliation.
The branchless final motion in 70:43 is used only as a structural intensifier of directed rushing, not as a branch citation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speed, an erected target, lowering, overpowering, and humiliation; I supply the vertical mapping that links these human motions to high mountains becoming limp. A live alternative is that the cosmic and human tableaux share a day but not a single spatial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The mountains' softness is a material loss of strength.
changed_reading.after: It joins a wider vertical reversal: what stood high loses resistance, while moving bodies are rushed toward an upright target and forced into lowered submission.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the mountain's abundance branch socially and infers loosening beyond the focus's explicit wool comparison. It remains anchored in the mountain and wool roots and is activated by gathering, enclosure, fixed entitlement, and deprivation. Downstream prose should present it only as a secondary material-social analogy, not as a replacement for the cosmic scene or as an explicit claim that the wool is already scattered.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The mountain's abundance branch becomes soft wool in a context that opposes gathered enclosure to claims held by others.

activation_trace.role: Mountain-like abundance supplies concentrated wealth or multitude as the outlier's focus-side anchor.
Soft wool supplies divisible fibers against the concentrated mass.
Gathering dispersed parts into one whole supplies deliberate accumulation.
Placing a thing inside a container supplies retention and refusal of circulation.
A specific right belonging to its holder supplies a claim that cuts across private enclosure.
Deprivation and missing the sought object identify the excluded recipient of the fixed claim.

changed_reading.before: The verse dissolves only a mass of rock.
changed_reading.after: As a contained outlier, it can also loosen the imagined mountain of amassed wealth into divisible fibers whose enclosure cannot cancel another's claim.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates a marginal speech branch of the comparison root rather than the ordinary wool sense. It remains anchored to that exact focus root and gains contextual pressure from unserious discourse continuing until an explicit warning is met. Downstream prose should label it as lexical wordplay or an epistemic afterimage and must preserve the primary material reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The comparison root includes speech cast out without reflection, while the mountain root includes a tightly made weave.

activation_trace.role: Firm weaving supplies the image of discourse that appears tightly constructed and resistant.
Speech cast out without reflection supplies the surprising epistemic endpoint of the unweaving.
Entering loosely into talk or an affair supplies the discursive setting for ungrounded confidence.
Action without a sound purpose supplies the lack of seriousness governing that discourse.
A threat directed toward coming harm supplies the reality against which loose speech is tested.

changed_reading.before: Mountain-to-wool concerns only the physical world's loss of structure.
changed_reading.after: As a contained lexical afterimage, mountain-solid human talk is also unwoven into careless speech when it meets the warned event.

strongest_changes: The focus moved from a color simile to a timed hard-mass-to-soft-fiber phase reversal within a paired sky-and-terrain material sequence.
The far-versus-near correction activated an obstacle-to-accessibility inversion, making material collapse also the removal of delay and mediation.
Kinship failure and created human disposition opened social-cohesion and anthropological readings while remaining anchored in the focus's mass, formed-nature, wool, and bending branches.
Natural durability was contrasted with maintained ethical durability, then explicit creation, power, replacement, and final vertical submission sharpened the image into a paradigm of reconfiguration.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots themselves hold unusually strong internal reversals: solid mass, firm weave, formed nature, and obstruction on one side; soft dyed fiber, limp bending, accessibility, and even unconsidered speech on the other. The context could therefore activate material, temporal, social, ethical, and epistemic mechanisms without detaching them from 70:9.
remaining_uncertainties: The accessibility and unconsidered-speech branches of the comparison root are form-distant from the ordinary noun and must remain exploratory.
The focus does not explicitly say that the wool is scattered or unspun, so de-weaving, granulation, and de-containerization add a directional inference.
The transfer of stability from geology to practice and the mapping from terrain to social or psychological structure are contextual analogies, not syntactic identifications.
